dynamic_line.yes: He was alone when the fires started and the world went to hell.  I was working on something.  I tried to make it to him, but the whole area was a war zone.  Things I can't describe lurching along, crushing people and worse.  Some people were trying to stop them, but hitting other people trying to get away as much as anything.  And then the collateral damage would get right back up and join the enemy.  If it hadn't been for my husband, I would have just left, but I did what I could and I slipped through.  I actually <freaking> made it alive.
